## 2. Regulatory & Safety Standards
- **Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 Compliance**: All vehicles operate with commercial Yellow Board passenger registration granted by the Karnataka State Transport Authority (KSTA).
- **All India Tourist Permit (AITP)**: Authorized for seamless interstate passenger transit across Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana without intermediate checkpost road tax stoppage.
- **AIS-140 Telematics Mandate**: 100% of vehicles are equipped with Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) certified AIS-140 GPS telemetry units, providing live geofencing, real-time speed tracking, and passenger emergency SOS panic buttons.
- **Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR) Speed Governance**: Commercial electronic speed governors restricted to 80 km/h on all high-capacity tourist and passenger buses.
- **Driver Standards**: Chauffeurs possess minimum 5+ years commercial highway driving records, verified police clearances, and proficiency in English, Hindi, and Kannada.
- **Taxation & Corporate Invoicing**: GST-registered operator issuing B2B tax invoices with full Input Tax Credit (ITC) pass-through.

## 3. Fleet Inventory & Technical Details

### Vehicle Category A: Tempo Traveller (12+1 Seater)
- **Chassis**: Force Motors Commercial Platform
- **Seating Capacity**: 12 Passengers + 1 Chauffeur
- **Seat Configuration**: 1x1 Captain Reclining Pushback Seats with Curtained Windows
- **Air Conditioning**: Dual-zone High Roof Mounted Climate Control
- **Luggage Capacity**: Dedicated Top Luggage Carrier + Rear Compartment
- **Safety**: AIS-140 GPS, First Aid Kit, Fire Extinguisher
- **Optimal Usage**: Family holidays, airport transfers (BLR Kempegowda Airport), corporate senior team transit, weekend getaways (8 to 12 persons).

### Vehicle Category B: Mini Bus (21+1 Seater)
- **Chassis**: Heavy Mercedes-Benz Platform, Coachwork by Singh Motor Coach Builders
- **Seating Capacity**: 21 Passengers + 1 Chauffeur
- **Seat Configuration**: Ergonomic High-Back Reclining Seats with Center Aisle
- **Air Conditioning**: Overhead Ducted AC with Individual Passenger Louvers
- **Luggage Capacity**: Underfloor Luggage Hold and Overhead Parcel Racks
- **Safety**: AIS-140 Telematics, Speed Governor (80 km/h limit)
- **Optimal Usage**: Mid-size corporate offsites, college department excursions, wedding guest transfers (14 to 21 persons).

### Vehicle Category C: Touring Bus (33+1 Seater)
- **Chassis**: Commercial Coach Platform
- **Seating Capacity**: 33 Passengers + 1 Chauffeur
- **Seat Configuration**: 2x2 Reclining Pushback Seats with Individual Reading Lamps
- **Air Conditioning**: High-capacity Engine-Driven AC
- **Luggage Capacity**: Deep Underfloor Luggage Bay for 35+ Suitcases
- **Safety**: Dual Emergency Exits, Emergency Glass Hammers, Fire Safety Systems
- **Optimal Usage**: School and university trips, religious pilgrimage circuits, multi-day interstate tours (22 to 33 persons).

### Vehicle Category D: Luxury Highway Coach (49+1 Seater)
- **Chassis**: Flagship 50-Seater Long-Distance Touring Platform
- **Seating Capacity**: 49 Passengers + 1 Chauffeur
- **Interior & Upholstery**: 49+1 Luxury Coach with red carpet aisle and plush pushback upholstery, ambient LED lighting
- **Air Conditioning**: Central Climate Control System
- **Entertainment**: Integrated LED Screen, Multi-speaker High-fidelity Audio, Bluetooth
- **Luggage Capacity**: Maximum Volume Underfloor Cargo Bay
- **Safety**: AIS-140 GPS, Dual Fire Extinguishers, Emergency Exits, First Aid Station
- **Optimal Usage**: Wedding Transport Logistics (Peak Nov–Feb Season), multi-vehicle coordinated convoys for weddings with 200+ guests, continuous shuttle loops between guest hotels and reception venues, destination weddings, major corporate summits, school batches, large pilgrimage groups (34 to 50 persons).

## 5. Booking Policies & Invoicing
- **Billing Method**: Local 8hr/80km packages or Outstation per-kilometer calculation with standard driver daily bata.
- **Tolls & State Taxes**: Calculated transparently based on actual FASTag and state transport department receipts.
- **Cancellation**: Free of charge up to 24 hours prior to scheduled pickup.
- **Payment Modes**: UPI, NEFT/RTGS Bank Transfers, Cash, Credit/Debit Cards, Corporate Purchase Orders.
